solution.title: Imprivata SSO, Badge-Tap & EPCS Integration for Clinical Endpoints

products.name: Imprivata SSO, Badge-Tap & EPCS Integration for Clinical Endpoints — Commercial
products.short_description: Deploy and configure Imprivata OneSign for clinical endpoints with Microsoft Intune — tap-and-go badge SSO, fast user switching, single sign-on into Epic and clinical web apps, and EPCS two-factor for controlled-substance e-prescribing. Self-guided, tested.
products.description:
Tap on, sign in, and prescribe securely — on every shared clinical endpoint

Clinicians lose minutes per shift to passwords on shared workstations, and controlled-substance e-prescribing demands strict two-factor. This solution deploys Imprivata OneSign through Microsoft Intune to shared clinical endpoints — the agent and proximity badge-reader drivers packaged as named Win32 apps — then configures tap-and-go SSO, fast user switching, single sign-on into Epic and clinical web apps, and EPCS two-factor (Imprivata Confirm ID). (Imprivata appliance/console policy values and EPCS/DEA identity-proofing come from your Imprivata admin and compliance team; this package owns the Intune deployment, endpoint configuration, identity integration, and validation.)

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the tap-and-go / fast-switch model, Epic SSO, and the EPCS two-factor workflow on shared clinical endpoints.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Imprivata OneSign + Confirm ID licensing, appliance reachable, proximity readers + drivers, Intune licensing, Entra/AD identity, shared-device model, EPCS enrollment/audit, compliance sign-off) with how to verify and how to implement it if missing, plus the category Global Requirements.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered, full-path steps: deploy the named Imprivata agent + reader-driver Win32 apps, scope the clinical device group, apply endpoint config, bind Epic/clinical-web SSO, enable tap-and-go + fast switching, and enable the EPCS two-factor workflow; pilot → validate → expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — tenant-readiness discovery, per-device validation (agent + reader + group), fleet coverage report, safe re-deploy remediation, and a clinical device-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with clear pass/fail gates (badge enrolls, tap logs in, SSO to Epic, EPCS two-factor completes, audit entries present), plus Best Practices.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Clinicians tap a badge to sign in and switch users in seconds on shared endpoints, single sign-on flows into Epic, and controlled-substance prescribing is protected by EPCS two-factor — deployed at fleet scale by your own team.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • IMPRIVATA-Discovery.ps1 — Imprivata SSO / Badge-Tap / EPCS - tenant readiness discovery (read-only)
    • IMPRIVATA-Remediation.ps1 — Imprivata SSO / Badge-Tap / EPCS - safe re-deploy of the named agent/driver app
    • IMPRIVATA-Report.ps1 — Imprivata SSO / Badge-Tap / EPCS - fleet coverage report to CSV (read-only)
    • IMPRIVATA-Set-ClinicalGroup.ps1 — Imprivata SSO / Badge-Tap / EPCS - create the 'IMPRIVATA - Clinical Endpoints'
    • IMPRIVATA-Validation.ps1 — Imprivata SSO / Badge-Tap / EPCS - per-device validation (read-only, PASS/FAIL)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
